The deadline to put in the tracker is 24 September. I've replied to Dana in #north-team with that.

Ilse first posted 20 November in #north-team on the 14th. The same morning she corrected it in #north-random, saying she'd read the wrong line and the real date is 24 September. Dana is in both channels.

That date has already passed. If Tamsin Cold Chain hasn't returned the signed order form, it's overdue, so I suggested Dana check with Ilse whether a new date was agreed. I haven't seen anything about a new date in either channel.

The brain still has the old 20 November entry. I tried to remove it but couldn't, because it said that entry doesn't exist. The correction to 24 September is saved and marked as replacing it, but anyone looking this up there could still see both dates.
